headline: Higher prices flip earnings to a solid profit
summary_short: Net sales rose 13% y/y to $11.3B on 14% higher local prices, lifting operating EPS to $0.71 from a $0.19 loss a year earlier; GAAP EPS was $0.62.
summary_long: Volume fell 1%, with Asia Pacific hurt most by Middle East conflict impacts. Operating EBIT rose to $887M as higher prices and self-help actions more than offset higher raw materials and logistics costs. Cash from operations was $1.8B and free cash flow $1.1B, with 84% trailing conversion. Dow paid $253M of dividends and cut debt about $600M year to date. The release gives no numeric earnings guidance.
confidence_notes: Operating EPS, Operating EBIT and free cash flow are non-GAAP. Operating EPS excludes $0.09 per share of significant items. Shard EPS values were not used where the release supplies both bases.

drivers.explanation: Local price rose 14%, led by Packaging & Specialty Plastics with higher polyethylene prices in all regions; currency was flat and volume fell 1%.
Higher prices and the company's self-help actions more than offset higher raw materials and logistics costs.
Improved earnings and working capital, including more than $400 million of working capital released in the quarter.
